message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard shows a strong, monotonic positive association: from Week 7 to Week 11, both advertising spend (x-axis) and sales (y-axis) increase together, with each successive week positioned further right and higher (Week 7: ~$30k spend/$60k sales; Week 11: ~$70k spend/$160k sales). However, the chart and page contain no profitability metric, causal method, or explicit approval threshold that maps this observed association to a budget approval. The task requires submitting an approval or evidence-review decision based on the dashboard. Since the dashboard provides only an observed association without the full-data, causal, or profitability evidence needed to justify a broader budget recommendation, the evidence-review option is the appropriate decision.", "option_label": "Select 'Hold and request full-data analysis'"}
